description: Cyclic Laboratory Test Data of Soil Samples from Adapazari, Turkiye is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Rodolfo Sancio, Geosyntec Consultants Inc. (geosyntec.com). Severe liquefaction-induced ground failure was observed in the Adapazari region following the 1999 Kocaeli, Turkiye earthquake. Many of the soils that failed were fine-grained and not traditionally considered susceptible to liquefaction at the time of the earthquake. Coverage: Kocaeli, Turkiye. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Cyclic Triaxial Testing, Cyclic Direct Simple Shear Testing, Liquefaction Susceptibility. Published 2025-05-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
